name: peckboard-print-farm-plugin
description: Peckboard WASM plugin — 3D printer farm control (Moonraker, OctoPrint, PrusaLink, Bambu via print-bridge) plus OrcaSlicer CLI slicing

scripts.build: node esbuild.js && extism-js dist/index.js -i src/index.d.ts -o dist/plugin.wasm
scripts.typecheck: node esbuild.js --page && tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p ui/tsconfig.json
